description: Use to check how far an organisation is with GDPR compliance, or to list what GDPR requires in practice. Call without input to get the 48 checklist items in 8 areas (lawfulness, transparency and rights, minimisation and retention, security, breaches, processors, accountability, international transfers), each with its article. Call with the ids done (and optional items not applicable) to get the completion score and the open items.

done.description: Ids of the items already in place

not_applicable.description: Ids of optional items that do not apply (only items marked optional)

name: gdpr_checklist_assessment
title: GDPR compliance checklist
